description: IoT protocols decomposed. MQTT keepalive + LWT + retained messages, CoAP observe, BLE GATT structure, Thread/Matter commissioning, LoRaWAN classes A/B/C, NB-IoT power saving modes.

sub_mechanisms.name: MQTT_keepalive
sub_mechanisms.definition: Client sends PINGREQ at configured interval. Broker disconnects if missed.
sub_mechanisms.why: Detect dead clients. Cellular IoT: long keepalive (minutes) for power. Tradeoff: detection time vs battery.

sub_mechanisms.name: MQTT_last_will_testament
sub_mechanisms.definition: LWT: message broker sends on behalf of client on unclean disconnect.
sub_mechanisms.why: Inform peers that device offline. Standard for presence detection. 'device-X/status offline' published on unexpected disconnect.

sub_mechanisms.name: MQTT_retained_message
sub_mechanisms.definition: Last published message on topic stored. New subscribers receive immediately.
sub_mechanisms.why: Late joiners get state without waiting. Useful for config + status. Cost: broker storage.

sub_mechanisms.name: MQTT_session_persistence
sub_mechanisms.definition: CleanSession=false: broker retains subscriptions + queued messages across disconnect.
sub_mechanisms.why: Intermittent device connectivity. Messages queued during offline; delivered on reconnect. Cost: broker storage + complexity.

sub_mechanisms.name: CoAP_observe
sub_mechanisms.definition: RFC 7641: subscribe to resource changes. Server pushes notifications on change.
sub_mechanisms.why: REST + pub/sub. Like MQTT but without broker. Server-direct observation. Used in LwM2M, embedded webs.

sub_mechanisms.name: CoAP_block_transfer
sub_mechanisms.definition: RFC 7959: split large payloads into blocks. Negotiated block size.
sub_mechanisms.why: Constrained devices can't handle large UDP datagrams. Firmware updates over CoAP use block transfer.

sub_mechanisms.name: BLE_GATT_service_characteristic
sub_mechanisms.definition: Service contains characteristics. Each characteristic has value, descriptors, properties (read/write/notify/indicate).
sub_mechanisms.why: Self-describing device API. Heart rate service has heart rate measurement characteristic. Standardised services across vendors.

sub_mechanisms.name: BLE_advertising_intervals
sub_mechanisms.definition: Advertising every 20ms-10s. Power-latency tradeoff. Connection interval: 7.5ms-4s.
sub_mechanisms.why: Trade discovery latency for power. Fitness tracker: rare adv = days battery. Mouse: frequent for responsiveness.

sub_mechanisms.name: Thread_commissioning
sub_mechanisms.definition: New device joins network. Commissioner (phone) authenticates + provisions credentials.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standardised onboarding. QR codes encode commissioning info. Border router bridges Thread to Wi-Fi. Foundation of Matter UX.

sub_mechanisms.name: Matter_device_attestation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Cryptographic proof: device is genuine, certified. PKI chain to vendor + CSA.
sub_mechanisms.why: Prevent counterfeit. Device has DAC (Device Attestation Cert) signed by vendor; vendor by CSA root. Verified during commissioning.

sub_mechanisms.name: LoRaWAN_class_A_B_C
sub_mechanisms.definition: Class A: device-initiated only. B: scheduled downlink. C: always-listening (mains-powered).
sub_mechanisms.why: Power-latency tradeoff. Class A: years on battery, downlink only after uplink. Class C: latency but always plugged in.

sub_mechanisms.name: NB_IoT_PSM_eDRX
sub_mechanisms.definition: Power Saving Mode + extended Discontinuous Reception. Device sleeps, network agrees.
sub_mechanisms.why: Battery years on cellular. PSM: device deep sleep, network buffers. eDRX: rare paging cycles. Trade: downlink latency.

derivation_rules.name: MQTT_keepalive_tradeoff_latency_battery
derivation_rules.why: PINGREQ wakes radio. Frequent = battery drain. Infrequent = slow dead-detection. Common: 60s for mains, 600s+ for battery.

derivation_rules.name: LWT_provides_offline_signalling
if: a client needs to signal abnormal disconnection
then: MQTT Last Will provides automatic offline notification
derivation_rules.why: Without: peers infer offline from missing data, slow. With: broker publishes 'offline' immediately on dead-detection. Standard pattern.

derivation_rules.name: BLE_advertising_dominates_battery_when_idle
derivation_rules.why: Adv interval 100ms = wake 10×/sec. Each wake costs μC. nRF52: 20μA average at 100ms adv. Tune to product requirements.

derivation_rules.name: Matter_attestation_prevents_counterfeit
then: attestation chain must verify against CSA root
derivation_rules.why: Without: any device claims Matter. With: cryptographic proof. Prevents commodity hardware impersonating certified devices. Foundation of Matter trust.

derivation_rules.name: Class_A_LoRaWAN_for_battery_years
if: sensor sends data periodically + tolerates downlink delay
then: Class A LoRaWAN enables years on battery
derivation_rules.why: Device sleeps 99%+. Wakes to send, then 2 short receive windows. Average current: μA. Class B/C trade for downlink responsiveness.
